cd /app && python3 -c "
from datasets import load_dataset
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct')
ds = load_dataset('ryanmarten/OpenThoughts-1k-sample', 'metadata', split='train')
sci = {'physics','chemistry','biology'}
rows=[r for r in ds if r['domain'] in sci]
print('n science rows', len(rows))
def cnt(texts):
    return sum(len(e) for e in tok(texts)['input_ids'])
reason=[r['deepseek_reasoning'] or '' for r in rows]
sol=[r['deepseek_solution'] or '' for r in rows]
cr=cnt(reason); cs=cnt(sol)
print('reasoning', cr)
print('solution', cs)
print('reason+sol', cr+cs)
" 2>&1 | grep -v Warning | grep -vi token_id
